candidates.change_summary: Return _msgSender() instead of _owner so owner() returns the caller rather than the stored owner.
Return the zero address instead of the stored owner.
Zero out _owner before returning, so owner() returns address(0) and persists the change.
Delete the `_;` statement so transferOwnership always reverts and the owner can never be changed.
Remove the `_checkOwner();` call so any caller passes the onlyOwner check and can set the owner to an arbitrary address.
Replace the ownership transfer target with the zero address so after transferOwnership the owner is address(0) instead of newOwner.
Replace the ownership transfer target with _msgSender() so after transferOwnership the owner becomes the caller instead of newOwner.
Delete the `_transferOwnership(newOwner);` statement so the owner remains unchanged after a call to transferOwnership.
Delete the zero-address require so the owner can be set to address(0) via transferOwnership, differing from P which reverts.
Insert an additional `_transferOwnership(address(0));` after the existing transfer so the final owner is always the zero address.
